defect: Amendment 02 also exported a job-specific VLLM_PORT base. Each job runs one vLLM server per GPU; both scanned from the same base and raced for one port, so every amendment-02 rerun (jobs 23037443-23037459) failed at vLLM start-up with DistNetworkError on exactly that base port. The defect was introduced by the amendment itself.
fix: VLLM_PORT export removed. No other job executed it: all other jobs were submitted before the change (Slurm executes its submission-time script copy). The 14 other trial records carrying the defective script hash (7B jobs 23033924-23033937, submitted 16:13) started while that file was on disk and record its hash because the harness hashed the checkout, not the executing copy; none shows a port failure. The harness now hashes Slurm's executing copy ($0).
rule: The 17 slots of amendment 02 run once more. No other slot is rerun; diagnosed memory outcomes are never rerun.
